resolution.note: K patches 0/7 -> 6/7 on the 7 refused units (k-fix2, regrade functional 1/7); worker rules in the lane brief, scope guard allows harness files outside scope and reports them

title: The D23 K arm produces a patch on every unit the plain harness does
body:
The D23 K arm produces a patch on every unit where the plain harness does.
Why: on the n100 test set (t-v41ny8g) K had no patch on 7 of 100 units (467,470,547,566,586,606,613) against P's 1 (436); those units drop out of the paired McNemar, and K-only wins (5) vs P-only (1-2) are too few for p<0.05.
Outcome: the cause of each missing K patch is named from .krn/runs/d23-comparison/n100/results/<unit>.K and fixed in K (or the replay), proven on those units.
Proof: a rerun of the 7 units gives K a patch on each.
Scope: src/, evals/d23/, test/.
